tools.clang: Android (13624864, +pgo, -bolt, +lto, -mlgo, based on r530567e) clang version 19.0.1 (https://android.googlesource.com/toolchain/llvm-project 97a699bf4812a18fb657c2799f5296a4ab2694d2)
tools.llvm_strip: llvm-strip, compatible with GNU strip (NDK r28c)

sources.a7_fire.c: the six fire shapes, one exported function per family: a7_anti_debug (ptrace PTRACE_TRACEME), a7_root_check (constant su paths to access/stat/fopen), a7_su_exec (execl/system/popen of constant su paths), a7_emulator_fingerprint (__system_property_get of ro.kernel.qemu / ro.hardware / ro.product.model with goldfish+ranchu comparison), a7_writable_dlopen (dlopen of /data/local/tmp, /sdcard, /data/data constant paths), a7_inline_syscall (svc #0 arm64, svc #0 Thumb, syscall + int 0x80 x86_64), plus the a7_run_all driver
sources.a7_nofire.c: the measured benign shapes: a7_unwinder (fopen /proc/self/maps), a7_crash_handler (PTRACE_ATTACH/SEIZE/CONT/DETACH on a forked child), a7_sdk_probe (__system_property_get ro.build.version.sdk), a7_shell_exec (execve /system/bin/sh), a7_soname_dlopen (dlopen libc++_shared.so / liblog.so)
sources.rootbeer/toolChecker.cpp: scottyab/rootbeer tag 0.1.2 rootbeerlib/src/main/cpp/toolChecker.cpp, verbatim (Apache-2.0): checkForRoot receives the su paths as a Java String[] and passes each to fopen, so the native side holds no constant su path (GLM-PROMPT.md measurement 4)
sources.rootbeer/toolChecker.h: same source tree and tag, verbatim
sources.java/com/scottyab/rootbeer/Const.java: the suPaths directory list from rootbeer 0.1.2 (Const.suPaths + getPaths()), the dex half of the join fixture
sources.java/com/scottyab/rootbeer/RootBeerNativ: rootbeer 0.1.2 RootBeerNative (loadLibrary("toolChecker") + the two native declarations), original package kept so the JNI join binds to the unmodified native exports
sources.java/com/scottyab/rootbeer/RootBeer.java: cut-down 0.1.2 RootBeer: checkForBinary builds path + "su" and hands the array to the native checkForRoot — the dataflow that moves the paths out of native sight
sources.java/com/example/blint/a7/Main.java: the fixture driver (root check plus one benign ro.build.version.sdk string)

builds.a7-classes.dex: javac --release 11 over java/... then d8 --release --min-api 24 --lib platforms/android-34/android.jar
builds.liba7_fire_<abi>.so: clang -O2 -fPIC -funwind-tables -shared a7_fire.c for abi in arm64-v8a (aarch64-linux-android24-clang), armeabi-v7a (armv7a-linux-androideabi24-clang), x86_64 (x86_64-linux-android24-clang), plus an llvm-strip --strip-all twin
builds.liba7_nofire_<abi>.so: same commands over a7_nofire.c, plus the stripped twin
builds.libtoolChecker_<abi>.so: same commands over rootbeer/toolChecker.cpp with -llog, plus the stripped twin
builds.a7-jni-<abi>.apk: aapt2 link --manifest AndroidManifest.xml -I android.jar --min-sdk-version 24 --target-sdk-version 34; zip in classes.dex + lib/<abi>/{liba7fire.so, liba7nofire.so, libtoolChecker.so}; zipalign -f 4 — one APK per ABI in arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64

expected.note: the R1 oracle, per rule x ABI; the call-site rules (1-5) read the call_site_arguments block, which absint only produces for arm64 and x86_64, so armeabi-v7a reports not-evaluated rather than a silent no-fire (ground rule 35); the inline-syscall rule is assembly-text-based and evaluates on every ABI. Rule ids are finalized in K2; the shapes are named here.

liba7_nofire.arm64-v8a: silent (crash handler attaches to a child)

libtoolChecker.arm64-v8a: silent (paths arrive from Java; no native constant)

liba7_fire.arm64-v8a: fire (svc #0 in a7_inline_syscall and the inlined copy in a7_run_all)

ANDROID_DEX_SU_PATHS_TO_NATIVE.a7-jni-<abi>.apk: fire at app level: the dex carries Const.suPaths and declares checkForRoot, which the JNI join binds to libtoolChecker.so's Java_com_scottyab_rootbeer_RootBeerNative_checkForRoot export
ANDROID_DEX_SU_PATHS_TO_NATIVE.a5-jni-<abi>.apk: silent: native declarations exist but no su-path strings (the committed A5 fixtures are this rule's no-fire case)
